root_text:
Alert ! 🚨

ICMR has detected two cases of Human Metapneumovirus ( HMPV ) in Bengaluru. 

HMPV is similar to SARS-COV-2 ( COVID-19 ), can cause respiratory disease in people of all age groups.

First case of HMPV was found recently in china.
